meta.name: seo-audit
meta.description: Use when reviewing a page or site for organic search, or diagnosing why something isn't ranking: crawl and index signals, on-page elements, content quality, and how to order the fixes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断网站排名问题,按优先级给出修复建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站搜索排名不理想,想找出原因并知道先改什么。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose ranking issues and get prioritized fixes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your site isn't ranking well and you need actionable, prioritized fixes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按优先级检查网页或网站的搜索表现：先查能否被收录，再看网站基础、页面优化、内容质量等。它会给出每个问题的证据、影响、修复顺序，并说明哪些无法检查。
howto.when: 当用户要求检查某个网页或网站的搜索表现，或诊断某个内容为什么没排上名时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个页面为什么没进搜索结果。
say.note: 它会先检查能否被收录，再查页面优化。

say.text: 检查我的网站为什么在 Google 搜不到。
say.note: 它会查看 robots、canonical 等收录信号。

say.text: 这个页面和头部结果差在哪？
say.note: 它会对比内容质量和可信度，给出修复顺序。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude checks a page/site's search performance in priority order: indexability first, then site basics, on-page optimization, content quality, etc. It gives evidence, impact, fix order for each issue, and what couldn't be checked.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user asks to review a page or site's organic search performance, or diagnose why something isn't ranking.

say_en.text: Audit why this page isn't appearing in search.
say_en.note: It checks indexability first, then on-page factors.

say_en.text: Check why my site doesn't show up on Google.
say_en.note: It looks at robots, canonical, and other indexing signals.

say_en.text: How does this page compare to the top results?
say_en.note: It compares content quality and credibility, then suggests fix order.
